name: AIDC pair-side accumulated burn
summary: AIDCToken adds 30% of every sell to accumulatedBurnAmount and, on the next ordinary transfer, burns that amount from the AIDC/WBNB pair and syncs it. The attacker bought AIDC through the whitelisted router, sold repeatedly via fresh helpers to pile up the pending burn, triggered burns that drained the pair's AIDC and sold into it for WBNB.
notes: Deployment reset: the burn-from-pair path and the router whitelist used for buying are set in the constructor; later owner calls (business contract, executeEnabled, scaleFactor, cooldown) do not affect the accumulated burn.

Net WBNB depletion of the AIDC/WBNB pair in the anchor (221.2258) and in the same attacker's follow-up burn-and-sell 0xfad7b540 (0.5492), at loss.mjs prices. Earlier AccumulatedBurnExecuted events were 30 and 6 AIDC from ordinary sells.
